comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Released as part of a 10th Anniversary celebration item set in UWO's East Asian servers (hence the 'X' decoration). It can (finally) be obtained on the Maris server via the Letter X Clothes Chest item released 5/6 from Treasure Cove. Stats:

Recognition +2
Search +2
Navigation +2
500 fame to equip, male-only, color-custom
